info.name: COMP3613 Assignment 2 - Student Awards API Tests
info.description:
API tests for the Student Awards app (FastAPI).

Run order matters: use the Collection Runner (or `newman run`) and run the whole collection in order.
Prerequisites: database seeded with `python manage.py init --drop` (users bob/admin, 3 awards with stock 10). The collection registers a fresh student on every run, and each run redeems one prize, so re-seed after ~10 runs.
Select the 'Local' or 'Render' environment to choose the server.
